Required Experience & Skills
•    5-6 years Microsoft SQL Server experience (SQL 2008/2012) with advanced T-SQL, writing stored procedures, views and triggers. Creating Indexes and constraints.
•    Strong knowledge of SSIS and SSRS
•    Deployment of SSIS Packages and SSRS reports
•    Experience working with SQL Profiler and Visual Studio Data Compare Tool
•    Database Administration, Tuning, Management and Security.
•    Experience working in a team-oriented and collaborative environment
